settings.label: Health Status
settings.help: Fallout 76 health and status presentation on the HUD.

settings.label: Weapon Condition
settings.help: Show the equipped weapon's condition bar on the HUD.

settings.label: Fallout 76 Quick Loot
settings.help: Use Fallout 76's quick-loot list and button prompts. Follows HUD Color and opacity.

settings.label: Fallout 76 Crosshair
settings.help: Use Fallout 76's crosshair art, transitions and spread animation. Follows HUD Color and visibility settings.

settings.label: Floating Damage Numbers
settings.help: Show Fallout 76-style numbers at your hits using actual health damage. Critical, sneak and weak-point hits use the larger bonus animation. Works in power armor. Requires the converted status HUD.

settings.label: Legendary Item Announcements
settings.help: Fallout 76 banner when you pick up a legendary item.

settings.label: Quest Announcements
settings.help: Fallout 76 banners for quest starts, completions and rewards.

settings.label: Favorites Wheel
settings.help: On: the Fallout 76 favorites wheel. Off: Fallout 4's stock favorites cross. Keeps your favorites and key binding.

settings.label: Dynamic Weapon Icons
settings.help: Favorites wheel draws each weapon's own silhouette, attachments included, instead of a category icon. A weapon's first appearance shows the category icon while its silhouette is generated.

settings.label: Fallout 76 Pip-Boy Tabs
settings.help: Fallout 76 inventory tabs in the Pip-Boy.

settings.label: Items Listed on NEW
settings.help: How many recent pickups the NEW tab lists.

settings.label: Inspect Card
settings.help: Item card shown when inspecting. Equipment Condition always uses the Fallout 76 card.

settings.label: Quick-Boy
settings.help: Allow the Quick-Boy overlay. Requires BACUP's Quick-Boy movie. Baka Fullscreen Pip-Boy keeps ownership when loaded.

settings.label: Pip-Boy View
settings.help: Use the normal Pip-Boy or the Quick-Boy overlay, including in power armor. Switching view in the Pip-Boy also saves this.

settings.label: Quick-Boy Size
settings.help: 1.0 is the source mesh size. Try 1.25 for a larger curved screen, up to 1.5. Check the edges for clipping.

settings.label: Quick-Boy Brightness
settings.help: Brighten menu text and icons without changing your color, the background or the arm view. 1.0 is the original brightness.

settings.label: L3 Switches View
settings.help: Reserve left stick click while the Pip-Boy has focus. Turn off if another mod uses L3.

settings.label: Custom Quick-Boy Color
settings.help: Off follows your Pip-Boy color on foot and your HUD color in power armor. On uses the color below.

settings.label: Equipment Condition
settings.help: Wear, enemy condition, broken-item blocking, repairs and condition bars.

settings.label: Ranged Wear
settings.help: Condition lost per ranged shot. 1.0 is normal, 0 disables wear.

settings.label: Automatic Fire Wear
settings.help: Multiplies ranged wear for automatic weapons. 0.75 means 25% less wear per shot.

settings.label: Melee and Bash Wear
settings.help: Condition lost per melee hit or weapon bash. 1.0 is normal, 0 disables wear.

settings.label: Armor Wear
settings.help: Condition lost when armor or power armor takes damage. 1.0 is normal, 0 disables wear.

settings.label: Special Stock at Weapon Dealers Only
settings.help: Restrict random legendary weapons, legendary mod boxes and improved repair kits to weapon dealers. Off allows all caps vendors.

settings.label: Legendary Weapon Chance
settings.help: Percent chance per fresh vendor weapon to gain a legendary effect. Rolled once per restock.

settings.label: Improved Repair Kit Chance
settings.help: Percent chance of one improved repair kit per vendor restock.

settings.label: Legendary Mod Box Chance
settings.help: Percent chance of one usable 1-3-star legendary mod box per vendor restock.

settings.label: Scrap to Stash Chance
settings.help: Percent chance of one Scrap to Stash per vendor restock, at any vendor.

settings.label: Outfits Over Armor
settings.help: Equip outfits over underarmor and armor, for outfits from the base game and mods.

settings.label: Chassis Storage
settings.help: Collect a power armor frame as a Power Armor Chassis item; a frame you climb out of returns to your inventory after 60 seconds.

settings.label: Tracked Frames
settings.help: How many of your most recently used frames are watched for automatic recall.

settings.label: Legendary Weapons
settings.help: Legendary enemies can carry legendary weapons.

settings.label: Legendary Armor
settings.help: Legendary enemies can carry legendary armor.

settings.label: Prefer Equipped Weapon
settings.help: Make the enemy's equipped weapon the legendary drop when possible.

settings.label: Exclude Robots
settings.help: Robots never roll legendary.

settings.label: Exclude Turrets
settings.help: Turrets never roll legendary.

settings.label: Discover Effects From Plugins
settings.help: Also use legendary effects found in other plugins.

settings.label: Minimum Rank for Legendary Types
settings.help: Lowest star rank given to creatures the game already marks legendary.

settings.label: Base Chance Multiplier
settings.help: Scales the legendary chance for every enemy.

settings.label: Chance per Enemy Level
settings.help: Percent chance added per enemy level above the minimum.

settings.label: Maximum Chance
settings.help: Cap on an enemy's legendary chance, in percent.

settings.label: Minimum Enemy Level
settings.help: Enemies below this level never roll legendary.

settings.label: Maximum Stars
settings.help: Highest star rank an enemy can roll.

settings.label: 1-Star Enemy Prefix
settings.help: Leave blank to keep the enemy's name.

settings.label: Item Name Prefix
settings.help: Text put before every legendary item's name.

settings.label: Effects in Item Names
settings.help: Name legendary items after their effects, as Fallout 76 does.

settings.label: Fallout 76 Hunger and Thirst
settings.help: Outside Survival, eating and drinking give Fallout 76's fed and hydrated buffs; empty needs cost nothing. Survival is unchanged.

settings.label: Fallout 76 Infestations
settings.help: Rotating Infestations in Appalachia regions with a fog search area, a replacement faction and an elite four-star boss. Off stops new sites; active sites still finish.

settings.label: Simultaneous Infestations
settings.help: At most one per region.

settings.label: Game Hours Between Infestations
settings.help: How long to wait before trying to start another Infestation.

settings.label: Area Loot
settings.help: Looting a corpse also lists the loot of every other corpse within the distance below.

settings.label: Corpse Highlight
settings.help: Dead actors that still hold loot glow like Fallout 76 corpses (orange for legendary actors).

settings.label: Only Highlight Your Kills
settings.help: Only mark creatures whose death was credited to you or an active companion this session.

settings.label: Distance
settings.help: Game units, for both area loot and the highlight. Fallout 76 uses 2100.

settings.label: Highlight Refresh (seconds)
settings.help: How often nearby corpses are rescanned. Lower reacts faster, higher costs less.

settings.label: Playable Ghoul
settings.help: Requires BACUP's player_ghoul.json catalog.

settings.label: Weathered Appearance
settings.help: Apply the converted ghoul face and skin after leaving menus, combat and power armor.

settings.label: Original Appearance
settings.help: Restore the face and skin saved before ghoul customization. Ghoul gameplay remains active.

settings.label: Return to Human
settings.help: Return to human after closing menus, leaving combat and exiting power armor.

settings.label: Continuous Exploration Music
settings.help: Like Fallout 76, the exploration track keeps playing through outdoor cells that have no music of their own instead of restarting with a new track.

settings.label: Raids
settings.help: Gleaming Depths can be started from the Fissure Site marker on the map.

settings.label: Recover at Checkpoint
settings.help: Dying inside a raid encounter returns you to its checkpoint and resets the encounter.

settings.label: XP Scale
settings.help: Fraction of Fallout 76's raid XP granted per encounter.

settings.label: Cap Stalker Damage
settings.help: The drill's stalker no longer kills in one hit.

settings.label: Stalker Damage Cap
settings.help: Largest fraction of your health one stalker hit can take.

settings.label: Drill Fuel Needed
settings.help: Fallout 76 needs 15; 0 keeps its value.

settings.label: Drill Wave Size
settings.help: Solo default; 0 keeps the Fallout 76 value.

settings.label: Drill Suicider Cap
settings.help: Solo default; 0 keeps the Fallout 76 value.

settings.label: Drill Wave Interval (seconds)
settings.help: Solo default; 0 keeps the Fallout 76 value.

settings.label: Squad Epsilon Eyebots
settings.help: Solo default; 0 keeps the Fallout 76 value.

settings.label: Eyebot Spawn Interval (seconds)
settings.help: Solo default; 0 keeps the Fallout 76 value.

settings.label: Stash Weight Limit
settings.help: Cap the weight your stash holds, as Fallout 76 does. Whatever would go over comes back to you. Scrapbox and ammo box contents don't count.

settings.label: Fallout 76 Respawn
settings.help: Move items from the enabled categories into your death container and choose a discovered map location. Off keeps Fallout 4's death flow. FO76 only applies while participating in a public event, Daily Op, or expedition mission.

settings.label: Drop Junk
settings.help: Drop junk and loose crafting components. Turn every drop category off to keep all items when respawning.

settings.label: Drop Aid
settings.help: Drop chems and other aid items. Food and drinks use their own toggle. Quest and favorited items stay with you.

settings.label: Drop Food and Drink
settings.help: Drop food and drinks, including water and Nuka-Cola.

settings.label: Drop Armor and Clothing
settings.help: Drop unequipped armor and clothing. Equipped, favorited and quest items stay with you.

settings.label: Drop Weapons
settings.help: Drop unequipped weapons with their attachments, names and condition. Equipped, favorited and quest items stay with you.

settings.label: Random Drop Amount
settings.help: Choose a random quantity from zero to the full count of each eligible stack. Off drops the whole stack. Applies only to enabled categories.

settings.label: Death Container
settings.help: Choose a converted Fallout 76 loot-bag appearance. Contents are preserved. An unavailable style falls back to the paper bag.

settings.label: Challenges
settings.help: Daily, weekly and lifetime challenges. While off, progress, rewards, HUD and the map panel are disabled; saved progress is kept.

settings.label: Perk Card Rewards
settings.help: Perk-card challenge rewards. Earned packs are kept while off.

settings.label: Realtime VATS
settings.help: Experimental. Unverified engine adapters keep vanilla VATS.

settings.label: Heal
settings.help: Use the available item with the highest health restoration. Fishing wins if both share a key.

settings.label: Start Fishing
settings.help: Start fishing when the fishing prompt appears.

settings.label: Switch Pip-Boy View
settings.help: Only while the Pip-Boy has focus.

settings.label: Open Photo Mode
settings.help: Opens Photo Mode in gameplay.

settings.label: Open Emote Wheel
settings.help: Opens the emote wheel in gameplay.

settings.label: Photo Mode
settings.help: Adds PHOTO MODE to the pause menu.

settings.label: Freeze Time
settings.help: Pause the world while Photo Mode is open.

settings.label: Photo Folder
settings.help: Where confirmed photos are moved. Blank uses Fallout 4's screenshot folder; relative paths start there.

settings.label: Fallout 76 Main Menu
settings.help: Use BACUP-converted Fallout 76 menu art and music/video.

settings.label: Random Menu Theme
settings.help: Pick a different Fallout 76 music/video pair on each main-menu entry.

settings.label: Photo Loading Screens
settings.help: Show your ProSnap or Photo Mode photos during loading.

settings.label: Fallout 76 Loading Screens
settings.help: Use BACUP-converted Fallout 76 loading art and layout. Photos take priority when enabled.

settings.label: Menu Music Volume
settings.help: Zero mutes it.

settings.label: Mute Menu Music
settings.help: Mute without changing the volume.

settings.label: Log Level
settings.help: Detail written to the Tales log in Documents/My Games/Fallout4/F4SE.

settings.label: New Game Start
settings.help: Fallout 4 plays the prewar intro and Vault 111 as normal. Fallout 76 skips it and wakes you in Vault 76 on Reclamation Day; leaving the vault starts "Out of Time". Read once when a new game begins; existing saves keep their start.
